title: Skewer the king and queen
text: Bh3 checks the king on f5 along the diagonal to c8. After the king moves, the bishop captures the queen behind it.

title: Check the defender’s threats
text: White has just played Bg2+, skewering the king and rook on b7. Black to move: ...Kc4 threatens ...Ra5 mate. Taking the rook with Bxb7 loses immediately. White must first meet the mating threat, giving Black time to save the rook.
